answer: An ember-lit juniper voyage passport gives every agent one earned identity. First, an agent stakes 50 tokens and a 25-dollar deposit before its first trade. Second, each completed voyage earns a signed stamp from its counterparty, and only five stamps across ten days unlock full trading rights. Third, peers audit a random 10 percent of voyages, and a failed audit burns the deposit and wipes the stamps. Forging a hundred fake identities would then cost 5,000 tokens and 2,500 dollars plus two weeks of real work, while honest agents grow like a juniper sapling adding one ring at a time.
